rationale: The plan uses DESeq2 Wald on raw Salmon counts with ~condition, control as reference, alpha 0.05 BH, apeglm shrinkage for ranking, plus an edgeR QL concordance check — exactly matching the reference for an unpaired 3v3 single-batch design, and it correctly declines to invent batch/covariate terms or to lower alpha. QC (library sizes, detected genes, VST PCA with loadings, correlation heatmaps, clustering) precedes the test with an explicit flag-only outlier policy that names the n=2 consequence. The low-count filter (count >=10 in at least 3 samples, the smallest group size) is minimal and justified; normalization stays inside the model via size factors and TMM, with an explicit prohibition on pre-normalized input. The power/stability step answers the confidence half of the question honestly, grounded in fitted dispersions and avoiding post-hoc observed power. Enrichment is well specified (ranked fgsea on shrunken LFC, 10k permutations, size window 15-500, BH, named human collections, mapped-fraction reporting, graceful absence handling), though it names the store contents rather than a versioned MSigDB release and GSEA on an n=3 ranking is of limited value — acceptable but slightly short of ideal.
